actual_dependencies.note: The older owned tree does not contain all current Main Socket prerequisites. They were read and compared in the peers; this unit does not recreate them.

ownership: Only owning host-thread API calls submit stack commands; actual uv handles and callbacks run on the private native loop thread.
No Engine or JSValue crosses the worker ABI. Wrappers and payloads retain the actual independently charged native memory owner.
An accepted endpoint is claimed once; discarding an unclaimed accept closes the actual accepted uv handle.
Read payload survives until event release; release frees payload before publishing ACK, and new demand is separate.
Actual uv close callback establishes closure. Stop prevents admission, drains native request/close callbacks and joins before final retirement.
libuv negative statuses including UV_ENOMEM remain ordinary status. Wrapper reservation/malloc failure has its own explicit allocation_failed producer.
The canonical Socket adapter retains actual provider/Entry/lease roots and completes C435 before publication; native packets are delivered on the owning host only.
remaining: Exact source intake then Root-granted compilation, actual metadata admission and raw physical runtime controls.
Canonical Socket adapter controls and public net.Server composition remain separate; the raw target does not compile or qualify that entire namespace.
HTTP Server/ServerResponse/IncomingMessage parser composition and full OAuth callback physical route remain separate.
DNS is not supplied by this numeric-address transport; no hostname fallback or detached success worker is used.
